{{Top|leg}}
The '''T3-OR''' was a model of [[Speeder bike/Legends|airbike]] that was used by the residents of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caarimon]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a group of [[Believers]] rented some T3-OR bikes from the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Joventusek]], and they used the vehicles to travel to the [[Desolation]], a barren and lifeless region of the planet.
